purpose: One create-only national posthoc personnel/history association release over all 5,087 accepted 2016-2022 C56 targets (10,174 views) and all 1,760 C59 program-seasons: exact same-season chain qualification, the three bounded roster rates recomputed from integer counts (null, never zero), the fixed NULL and unchanged C47 smoothed controls and exactly two frozen zero-intercept lambda-1 L2 logistic fits (history only; history plus the three roster-rate differences) on one common cohort fitted only on 2016-2020, with game-grain scores and descriptive summaries served only through the explicit bas-retrospective-baseline-query --personnel-association mode.

research_authority.label: POSTHOC_ROSTER_ASSOCIATION_NOT_FORECAST
permits: retrospective association of 2023-observed season roster set rates with already-exposed 2016-2022 outcomes
exactly the two frozen research fits after this contract is committed
does_not_permit: historical PIT or pregame availability claims
model search, tuning or a positive-lift requirement
calibration, skill, champion or causal personnel claims
research_authority.parent_flags: every parent target_game_feature_eligible, protected_eligible and PIT flag unchanged false

SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1.formula: q_X = (W_X + T_X/2 + 1)/(G_X + 2) for each side X; p_A = q_A(1-q_B) / (q_A(1-q_B) + q_B(1-q_A)); p_B = 1 - p_A
SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1.cold_start: G = 0 gives q = 1/2 (flagged; the target is kept)

POSTHOC_HISTORY_L2_V1.formula: p_A = sigmoid(z . beta), z the FIT-RMS-scaled A-minus-B design, zero intercept
POSTHOC_HISTORY_L2_V1.objective: mean weighted binary cross-entropy over the paired FIT rows (weight 1/2 each) plus (1/2) sum(beta_j^2) (lambda 1, every column)

POSTHOC_HISTORY_ROSTER_L2_V1.formula: p_A = sigmoid(z . beta), z the FIT-RMS-scaled A-minus-B design, zero intercept
POSTHOC_HISTORY_ROSTER_L2_V1.objective: mean weighted binary cross-entropy over the paired FIT rows (weight 1/2 each) plus (1/2) sum(beta_j^2) (lambda 1, every column)

design.history_log_odds: ell_s = math.log(2*wins_s + ties_s + 2) - math.log(2*losses_s + ties_s + 2) with the integer arguments formed exactly and the two binary64 logarithms of the pinned CPython subtracted once (the logit of the unchanged C47 smoothed q_s = (W + T/2 + 1)/(G + 2))
design.history_counts: the accepted C56 feature record's same-season, strictly earlier-date wins, losses, ties and games of each side, the target excluded, with the contributing contest keys retained as lineage
design.roster_rates: retention = returning/prior, Jaccard = returning/union, arrival = arrival/current: Python float division of the two integers (correctly rounded), each with a positive denominator; the parent's stored rate must equal it exactly
design.roster_columns: team rate minus opponent rate for retention, Jaccard and arrival, in that order (one binary64 subtraction each)
design.orientation: view A is the canonical (parent a) side; view B's team-minus-opponent columns are the exact negations of A's
design.missing: a side without a joinable same-season summary has a null roster block, never zeros; the game is outside common support and every model abstains
excluded_from_design: talent, availability, transfer, NIL, weather, film or market proxy

scaling.rule: scale_j = math.sqrt(math.fsum(0.5 * x_ij * x_ij for every paired FIT row i, A then B, in canonical game order) / N_fit_games); no centering (odd orientation symmetry preserved); a zero scale is 1 and the column is marked constant; z_ij = x_ij / scale_j
scaling.rows: the FIT cohort only (common-support 2016-2020 games with a DECISIVE label); never a comparison season, never transductive
scaling.shared: both fitted models use the same history-column scale

fit.cohort: common-support games of 2016-2020 whose accepted label is DECISIVE
fit.rows: per game the A row (z, y_A) and the B row (-z, 1 - y_A), each of weight 1/2
fit.failure: a refused fit (FIT_EMPTY, FIT_RAGGED, FIT_NONFINITE_INPUT, FIT_NONFINITE, FIT_NOT_CONVERGED, FIT_SINGULAR, FIT_BACKTRACK_EXHAUSTED) is recorded with its trajectory as the parameter state; that model then abstains on every game (ABSTAIN_FIT_FAILED); no constant is tuned afterwards
fit.comparison_years: never in the fit, the scales, any constant or any selection

estimates.game_grain: the A-orientation probability is built first; B is its exact complement

fixed.SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1: the unchanged C47 exact rational q_A(1-q_B)/(q_A(1-q_B)+q_B(1-q_A)), q = (2W+T+2)/(2G+4), equal to the accepted C47 estimate record

estimates.fitted: p_A = decimal12(rf.sigmoid(rf.linear(z_A, beta))); p_B = 1 - p_A exactly in decimal; the linear predictor decimal12 and both unrounded values as repr() text are kept
estimates.support: only common-support games are estimated; every other game abstains for all four models with ABSTAIN_OUTSIDE_COMMON_SUPPORT and the sides' reasons

scores.orientation: A (the canonical game); each canonical game is counted once per model
scores.brier: (p_A served - y_A)^2 as an exact rational of the served probability (fixed models: of their exact rational)
scores.log_loss: -math.log(clip(q)) with q the correctly rounded binary64 of the exact served probability of the observed side, clip to [1e-15, 1 - 1e-15] applied only to the argument (CLIPPED_LOG_ARGUMENT_1E-15); repr() text

unscored.LABEL_TIE: a tie is never made decisive

summary.scopes: SEASON 2016..2022, PARTITION FIT (2016-2020) and PARTITION COMPARISON (2021-2022); no pooled in-sample plus comparison mixture
summary.per_model: score records, scored and unscored games by reason, Brier total and mean (exact rationals with decimal12), log loss total (math.fsum in canonical game order) and mean (repr)
summary.fit_partition: FIT-partition rows of the fitted models are fitted-data (in-sample) summaries
summary.primary: POSTHOC_HISTORY_ROSTER_L2_V1 minus POSTHOC_HISTORY_L2_V1 Brier mean on PARTITION COMPARISON (pooled 2021-2022), unfiltered: negative = lower descriptive Brier, zero = equal, positive = higher
summary.common_support: every compared model has the identical scored game keys in each scope, except that a fitted model whose frozen fit failed abstains on every game (ABSTAINED_FIT_FAILED, zero scored games) and its comparisons carry no difference
summary.selection: with any season/team/contest/partition selector the rows and comparisons are re-derived over exactly the selected canonical games' verified score records; a scope without a selected game has no row; --model keeps that model's rows and the comparisons whose subject is that model; paging follows the calculation
summary.no_inference: no significance, bootstrap, calibration, champion, causal or predictive-skill conclusion

numeric.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 in a fixed order; every reduction math.fsum; math.log, math.exp, math.log1p and math.sqrt of the pinned CPython 3.12.10
numeric.decimal12: a served binary64 value is its exact decimal expansion rounded half-even to 12 places (negative zero normalized) as a JSON string; complements and negations are exact decimal operations
numeric.rationals: {numerator, denominator} JSON integers in lowest terms, denominator > 0
numeric.floats: binary64 rates, log-odds and design values are JSON numbers (finite; their repr round-trips exactly)
numeric.counts: JSON integers only, within their domain; a boolean or an integral float is not a count
numeric.independent_tolerance: an independent oracle agrees within 1e-9 absolute on scales, coefficients, objective and probabilities and within 1e-8 on gradients; keys, counts, states, identities and exact rationals agree exactly; byte identity of rebuilds is a separate property
numeric.canonical_json: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8

join.key: (target season, accepted C56 team key org:<id>) -> that exact C59 program-season <season>|org:<id>
join.chain: the program-season's chain_state must be QUALIFIED_EXACT_CHAIN
join.summary: its own returning_target_summary_key must name a C59 returning summary whose target season is the same football season (the parent's label, including its 2020 semantics) and whose canonical team is the chain's canonical team

grains.qualifications: one record per C59 program-season (<season>|org:<id>), all 1,760
grains.features: one record per accepted 2016-2022 target view (<contest_key>|<view>)
grains.estimates: one record per target, model and orientation (<contest_key>|<model>|<orientation>)
grains.scores: one A-oriented record per target and model (<contest_key>|<model>)

ordering.features: season, contest_date, contest_key, view (A then B)
ordering.estimates: season, contest_date, contest_key, model (NULL, SMOOTHED, HISTORY, ROSTER), orientation (A then B)

layout.serialization: canonical JSON lines (sorted keys, separators ',' ':', UTF-8, no ASCII escaping); one zlib level-9 block per seasonal table and season, one GLOBAL block each for parameters and summary

ddl: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE blocks (ord INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, record_table TEXT NOT NULL, segment TEXT NOT NULL, records INTEGER NOT NULL, first_key TEXT, last_key TEXT, lines_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, block BLOB NOT NULL)

identity_documents.identity: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes of the document; compared as canonical bytes, never by Python equality (an integral float, a boolean or an extra member differs)
identity_documents.location: <root>/canonical/national_personnel_association_2016_2022/sha256/<database identity>/national_personnel_association.sqlite; manifest at <root>/manifests/national_personnel_association_2016_2022/sha256/<database identity>/run_manifest.json with members identity, identity_document, content_identity, content_document and provenance; create-only (identical rebuild ALREADY_PRESENT_IDENTICAL, differing bytes REFUSED_IMMUTABLE_COLLISION)

layout.checkpoint_unit: one study season: its qualification, feature, estimate and score lines; parameters and the summary follow

selectors.season: an integer; the study seasons are 2016-2022 (any other season serves no row with SEASON_OUTSIDE_RELEASE; 2023 is never a study season)
selectors.team: org:<1-12 digits> or bare digits (the accepted C56/C59 team key), or an exact team name the record's own season carries for that team (never borrowed across seasons); an unknown valid team serves no row
selectors.contest: an exact accepted contest key ncaa:<digits> (bare digits read as ncaa:<digits>); an unknown valid contest serves no row
selectors.model: one of NULL_HALF_V1, SMOOTHED_HISTORY_ODDS_V1, POSTHOC_HISTORY_L2_V1, POSTHOC_HISTORY_ROSTER_L2_V1
selectors.paging: --limit (default 50, non-negative), --offset (non-negative) or --all; exact totals in record order; summary paging follows its calculation
selectors.intersection: every applicable supplied selector applies and they intersect; an unknown or disjoint valid selection serves no row, summaries included (never a fabricated zero-count summary)
selectors.pit: --require-pit is always refused; no historical as-of selector exists

refusals.stderr: one JSON object with members refused (the code) and error (the text); nothing on stdout

scope.population: all 5,087 accepted C56 2016-2022 targets (10,174 oriented views) and all 1,760 C59 2016-2022 program-seasons; the common cohort is the games whose two participants both bind a same-season summary
scope.not_in_scope: 2023 study rows or scores, 2024/2025 protected seasons, prospective or production training, forecasts, availability, talent, transfers, coaching, weather, film, market, NIL and A&M specialization

consumer.help: the original parser's --help gains exactly one paragraph naming the mode
